name: Telmisartan
mechanism: Blocks AT1 receptors preventing vasoconstriction and aldosterone release
contraindications: Pregnancy, bilateral renal artery stenosis, hyperkalaemia
interactions: NSAIDs (↓ effect, ↑ renal impairment), potassium-sparing diuretics (hyperkalaemia)
monitoring: U&Es (especially within 1-2 weeks of starting), blood pressure
pharmacokinetics: Longest half-life of ARBs (24h), high lipophilicity
clinicalPearls: Good option for once-daily dosing. Also has PPAR-gamma agonist activity
indication: Hypertension, cardiovascular risk reduction in high-risk patients
